pr_comments:
After a shear is caused by `RotationEditMode::Basis`, if `RotationEditMode` is changed to `Quaternion` or `Euler`, the shear remains. Orthogonalization is required when changing the mode.

In addition, errors frequently occur in `RotationEditMode::Quaternion`.
```
ERROR: Basis must be normalized in order to be casted to a Quaternion. Use get_rotation_quaternion() or call orthonormalized() if the Basis contains linearly independent vectors.
   at: (core\math\basis.cpp:718)
```
@TokageItLab Not sure what you mean by shear, but did some further fixes so make sure to try again.

The problem of the frequent Quaternion errors has been resolved.

In Basis mode, local shearing is allowed. However, in Quaternion and Euler modes, shear is forced to be orthogonalized during transformation, so it should be orthogonalized when changing modes, since currently the following implicit and abrupt orthogonalization is done, which is uncomfortable:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/61938263/175789345-a2392088-f5ab-4a3a-bffd-0e2e557eb4c8.mp4

One way to do this would be to call `_update_local_transform()` when changing modes.

However, `data.euler_rotation` and `data.scale` are not recorded in the `.tscn` file when the scene is saved. This causes `data.euler_rotation` and `data.scale` to have initial values when the scene is loaded, which causes problem #62225 which is a mistake I have made in #53684.
Okay, I guess this should be ready to go

Is it okay to save Node3D with Euler 720 degree and when you load the scene it becomes Euler 0 degree? `.tscn` does not save the euler value directly, so when you load the scene it is forced to convert from Basis.
Otherwise it looks good.
@TokageItLab Hmm you are right, let me see if I can do this a bit different, otherwise the order of properties becomes the problem.
@TokageItLab okay I guess it should be ok now.

issue_context.title: Rotation is not applied on scene load, if rotation_edit_mode is set to Quaternion.
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 Alpha 10

### System information

Archlinux, KDE X11

### Issue description

If a node has rotation_edit_mode set to Quaternion, then its rotation is either not loaded when loading its parent scene, or saved incorrectly. When set to Euler angles it works correctly.



### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new 3D scene, add to it any rotatable 3D node
- Rotate the node in some way
- Save the scene, and then reload it
    - Rotation is loaded correctly
- Set Rotation Edit Mode to Quaternion on the node
- Save the scene and reload it
    - Rotation is reset to the default value.

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: This problem is also caused by `Basis` mode.

Reopend by #62393.
There is a problem with the way of the storing the Euler value and it needs to be fundamentally refactored.
